title: Pass data between jobs reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for pass data between jobs should include: GITHUB_OUTPUT, outputs:, needs:.
answer.example:
name: Pass a small value between jobs
on: workflow_dispatch
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      label: ${{ steps.make.outputs.label }}
    steps:
      - id: make
        run: echo "label=demo-${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  consume:
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - env:
          LABEL: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.label }}
        run: echo "Received label=$LABEL"
answer.verification: The prepare job exports a small string as a job output; the dependent job consumes that string through `needs.prepare.outputs.label`. Outputs are not a file-transfer mechanism.
